authority: examples/points.example.csv shows the exact column order; all core columns must remain. Extra columns are optional strings. Changes invalidate dependent stages.
row_rules: One coordinate-bearing row per resolved source instance. Unique point_id AND source_instance_id.
All coordinate-bearing CSV stages contain only policy-eligible CO2 series. Excluded series may be recorded as non-coordinate audit metadata but never as CSV rows.
All CSV rows require export_eligible=true and nonempty CO2 species evidence.

is_inferred=true only for line_sample and template_fill rows (series template placed on a crowded-strip slot between real markers of that series); these rows always go to review. Other hypotheses stay in unresolved metadata.
Native coordinates are finite and lie inside source plot. x/y calculated only with valid axes; otherwise blank.
uncertainty_x/y optional, finite nonnegative, in reported data units; do not manufacture certainty.

Native reviewer evidence kind, item reference, source description, and raw uncertainty_px are retained in stage metadata and notes. uncertainty_x/y are the calibrated axis-unit projection of uncertainty_px when calibration is valid.
normalized_x/y optional. Populate only through documented conditional conversions, with conversion_id(s).
line_sample rows require marker_shape=none; sampled lines are not original experimental points.
